## Current Projects

### [Merim.org](https://merim.org/)

[Jul 2025 — Sep 2025 / Berlin, Germany - Sofia, Bulgaria]{.text-muted .tabular-nums}

Merim.org is an app that allows users to track supermarkets' prices during the period of rapid price changes because of the ongoing Eurozone accession of Bulgaria.

[Pricing Market Research]{.badge-custom} [Mobile App Development]{.badge-custom}

### [Opinify](https://opnify.net/)

[Sep 2024 — Dec 2025 / Berlin, Germany - Sofia, Bulgaria]{.text-muted .tabular-nums}

Opinify broadens the user case of "Probah" - And instead of focusing on fashion makes the platform industry agnostic. The platform is an analytical platform for research, analysis and reporting. Look up more at https://opnify.net/ . Under active development.

[SaaS Platform]{.badge-custom}

### [Probah](https://probah.com/)

[Sep 2022 — Dec 2023 / Berlin, Germany - Sofia, Bulgaria]{.text-muted .tabular-nums}

Analytical platform for research, analysis and reporting. The project aimed to aid companies and brands with fashion portfolio optimization problems. Look up more at https://probah.com/

[Portfolio Optimization]{.badge-custom} [Web App Development]{.badge-custom}
